errors.evidence: The x-axis labels (for 'година' / 'year') are at 5-year intervals (2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020), not one-year intervals.

The description fails to link the plotted lines to their respective labels in the legend (EC, ОИСР, САЩ, Япония, България). It describes the lines by invented visual attributes instead of their actual names, making the data description unusable.

errors.evidence: The entire paragraph describing the data trends is incorrect because it is based on hallucinated line descriptions. The numerical values and trends described do not correctly correspond to any of the actual lines in the plot. For example, the line described as starting at 19.84 does not exist (the highest line, Japan, starts at ~22.5), and the line described as starting at 10.12 is said to decrease, while the actual line in that range (OECD) consistently increases.
